procedure.procedureText:
Action; native60 feet; V/S/F; native rank9/base26RP through Cleric/Druid/Wizard Necromancy. NEW a caster-origin60-foot3D sphere, intersecting actual creature occupied bodies and clipped by actual solid total cover. Freeze every qualifying living enemy at manifestation without a numerical target cap. NEW enemy admission means a creature actually perceived and designated hostile from the caster's existing perception/encounter knowledge; an unknown hidden allegiance or hidden unperceived creature is not exposed or added by this spell. Fix this predicate before rolls. No selectively excluded known qualifying enemy may be omitted to improve a result.

NEW roll one shared6d10 necrotic pool for this cast; each frozen recipient makes its own CON save at the actual source DC, success halves with floor and failure takes full. Create a distinct original-recipient root for every recipient before resolving the first packet, all linked to the one cast/shared roll. Resolve recipients in stable identity order fixed at admission; finish each damage event and its legal reactions before the next. Later caster death does not recall an already manifested area or erase remaining admitted events. Later independent target ineligibility is recorded and does not add a replacement recipient.

After all those damage/reaction events, attempt exactly one numeric ordinary heal on the original caster equal to the eligible actualDamageDealt total. For each root count each permitted terminal branch once: real tempHP absorbed plus actual normalHP lost, excluding prevented damage, overkill and loss caused solely by a separate state assignment. Never count the unsplit parent in addition to its children or unrelated retaliation damage. A transferred branch must independently satisfy the spell's frozen hostile-recipient predicate and its own source's healing restrictions; a friendly protector or a no-derived-healing branch contributes0. The damage split itself still resolves in full. A new reactive damage root cannot recursively become Harvest yield.

There is no new arbitrary heal cap or resource reserve. This is a numeric heal, not6d10 healing dice. Apply only actually applicable healing modifiers/prohibitions, effective maximum, Critical ceiling and source-qualified finite reserves. Passive-regeneration-only limits do not become global caps on this finite paid heal. If the caster is Dead, otherwise not a legal living healing recipient, or prohibited from healing, actual restoration is0; no resurrection, damage reversal or cost refund occurs. Record the entitlement total separately from the permitted/restored amount. Genuinely Null-nonlethal roots can still deal numeric actual damage; they follow their exact zero-state/lifecycle override without becoming soul theft. No soul custody, RP reserve or death farming is granted by the name.
